parameters.name: ArchiveDuration
parameters.description: The number of days for automatic archiving after storage expires. Valid values: 60, 90, 180, and 365. A value of 0 indicates no archiving.

parameters.name: AuthFreeReadPolicy
parameters.description: The list of IP addresses for authentication-free read. CIDR notation is supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with line feeds.

parameters.name: AuthFreeWritePolicy
parameters.description: The list of IP addresses for authentication-free write. CIDR notation is supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with line feeds.

parameters.name: EnableAuthFreeRead
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable authentication-free read.

parameters.name: EnableAuthFreeWrite
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable authentication-free write.

parameters.name: EnableAuthToken
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable access token authentication.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:
- POSTPAY: Pay-as-you-go based on metric reporting volume.
- POSTPAY_GB: Pay-as-you-go based on metric write volume.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID of the Prometheus instance.

parameters.name: StorageDuration
parameters.description: The data retention period, in days.
